title: UCBRx1 LoRaWAN: STM32WL55 Firmware and Experimental Measurement Dataset
description: Firmware, experimental measurement data, and processing resources associated with ACK-timing-aware UCB-based device-side channel learning on an STM32WL55 LoRaWAN Class-A end device. The repository supports the measurement-based energy characterization and experimental evaluation reported in the associated study, including MCU-side learning overhead, confirmed-uplink energy consumption, ACK reception in WinRx1 and WinRx2, channel-selection statistics, and service-energy performance.
